messages:
Alana: Quick idea — low-key Sunset Crawl + bites + boardgames this Wed (6:30pm). Thinking rooftop at The Finch or the Taproom downstairs. Karaoke afterwards if folks want. React with :one: for Finch rooftop, :two: for Taproom. Also drop a 👍 if you can commit and any diet stuff.
Mike: :one: from me. Rooftop for the view. I can bring Codenames and pick up sushi if people want (I can do veggie rolls too).
Priya: Count me in! Prefer rooftop. I'm vegetarian + dairy ok.
Noah: Taproom has better beers but rooftop sounds nicer for sunset. Happy either. I can bring my Switch for Jackbox later.
Jae: I can make 6:30 but will need to leave ~9. Rooftop works if there's seating. Happy to karaoke after for a quick set.
Mike: I have 2 extra car seats if anyone wants a ride from Mission St meetup at 6:10.
Priya: I'll chip in $10 for group order if we do sushi. Also need GF option pls.
Alana: Nice — rooftop winning so far. If you can, please react with 👍 to actually RSVP so I can reserve a table. I'll handle booking and a group order link. Meetup spot: `Lobby by the murals at 6:15` (so we can walk over).
Slackbot: Reminder scheduled — RSVP deadline Tue 12:00pm. Capacity note: rooftop max 20.
Noah: 👍 booked me in (can stay later). Thanks Alana!
Jae: 👍 in.
Mike: 👍, I'll be in the Mission lobby at 6:05 with sushi pickup plan.
Priya: 👍 thanks! Vegetarian + GF noted.
Alana: Awesome, I'll send the reservation link and the group-order poll tomorrow. If anyone needs a later pickup time or to join just for karaoke, say so here. :)
